verifiedExistingMethods: DOLPHOT's JWST modules perform crowded-field PSF fitting on calibrated exposures and provide artificial-star tests.
DOLPHOT artificial-star output preserves one row per injected star and represents non-detections explicitly, enabling completeness and residual estimates.
Photutils segmentation labels identify pixel islands, and deblending depends on threshold levels and contrast; a label is not an external scientific identity.
Photutils supports fixed-position forced PSF fitting, while linearized field-deblending and Bayesian star-field methods already address blended scenes.
The Perfect Host paper used DOLPHOT and artificial-star tests and reported aggregate F150W crowding bias and dispersion by region.

noveltyBoundary: No constituent method is claimed as new. The research proposal is a testable combination of stable target identities, a segmentation-collision graph, one-at-a-time artificial-star interventions, disjoint development and validation identities, and an independent scene reduction.
